explains.what: A match has to account for every possible value of what it is matching on. A u8 runs from 0 to 255, and these two ranges stop at 254, so 255 has no arm. The compiler rejects it before anything runs, with error E0004, and even names the value that is missing.
explains.takeaway: Exhaustiveness is checked for every type, including integer ranges. If you want a fallback, add a final _ arm, or write the last range as 100..=255 so the gap closes by itself.
